description: Step into timeless elegance with this exceptional apartment, set in a French Heritage building with a grand stone staircase that hints at the apartment’s prestige, in the heart of the Marais neighborhood. Boasting an impressive 4m/12ft ceiling height, it features a stunning Versailles parquet floor, intricate moldings, and exquisite marble fireplaces. Its 5 bedrooms offer comfort and intimacy, with 5 en-suite bathrooms. This fully renovated home subtly blends sophistication with Parisian style.The spaceNeed to store your luggage? We can help arrange its pickup before your arrival and after your departure, contact us!Important: No elevator in the building - the apartment is accessible through the stairs on the 2nd floor (75 steps to climb)The apartment includes: - 1 Living room- 1 Dining area with seating for 12- 1 Separate and fully equipped kitchen- 5 Private bathrooms (see below)- 1 Separate WCThe sleeping arrangement is organized as follows: - Bedroom 1 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower and no WC)- Bedroom 2 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (bathtub with WC)- Bedroom 3 with a Kingsize bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower and no WC)- Bedroom 4 with a Kingsize bed (or two twin beds) and private bathroom (shower with WC)- Bedroom 5 with a double bed and en-suite private bathroom (shower and no WC)- Living room convertible into a bedroom: 1 sofa bed for two peopleThe apartment is ideal for 10 and can accommodate up to 12 people.The surface area is 232 m² / 2402 sq ft. The apartment is equipped with:- A/C- Bath and bed linen- 5-star bedding - Toiletries (shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, toilet paper)- High speed Wifi- TV- Washer dryer - Hair dryer- Nespresso coffee machine- Water boiler- Toaster - Fridge- Induction cooking pl
